name: Ford - Dearborn Truck Plant, Dearborn MI

fieldNotes.facility: Dearborn Truck Plant inside the Ford Rouge Complex; coords land exactly on the DTP's 10.4-acre living (green) roof, an unmistakable landmark confirming identity.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Rouge Complex is a fully fenced, controlled-access campus. Truck and employee traffic enters via guarded Miller Rd gates; gate infrastructure, fencing and Ford gate signage visible in Street View.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Rouge operates staffed security gatehouses at its entrances (standard for the campus); booth structures present at controlled entries.
fieldNotes.multiStep: Campus-scale security: outer Rouge perimeter gate, then internal plant-specific checkpoints before DTP docks.
fieldNotes.railServed: Multiple active rail spurs run directly through the property; long covered rail auto-rack loading structures for finished F-150s are visible NW of the plant.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: DTP is one plant within the larger integrated Rouge manufacturing campus (stamping, frame, other buildings adjacent).
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Estimate from overhead imagery; docks distributed across multiple building faces of a very large assembly building plus parts-receiving banks.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly identified in imagery; left uncertain.
